title: Bind task outcomes to residual risks

sources.reason: Defines the current machine-readable Task Outcome shape.
Defines the existing fail-closed Outcome validation boundary.
Projects evidence and event records into the immutable Outcome.
Projects Task Outcome truth into the human-facing report.
Maps the affected human-report and Contract-validation capabilities to authoritative source and test evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item changes the machine truth used to present warnings, limitations, residual risks, and forbidden claims; an incorrect mapping could hide unresolved evidence gaps.

reasons: The change affects governance schemas, validation, generated reports, and their regression tests.

executionDecision.reason: The user supplied the required behavior, scope is bounded to Outcome governance, and focused regression tests can prove the rules.

preReviewWarnings: This bootstrap Contract uses the currently supported fields while the Work Item first adds the new Contract metadata required for all subsequent Work Items.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the pre-edit and pre-finish scope, acceptance, and evidence state for this governance change.

acceptance: Task Outcome validation rejects every non-empty warning list unless each warning has a structured limitation and either a residual-risk record or a nonRiskExplanation record.
Task Outcome validation rejects not-run evidence without an explicit limitation and rejects incompatible enterprise-ready or platform-verified claims.
High-severity residual risks carry a decision owner, required evidence, mitigation, acceptance state, and forbidden claims; completed_with_warnings reports contain explicit forbidden claims.
The JSON outcome, derived Markdown, and human report render the same limitations, residual risks, and forbidden claims.
The Contract validator supports the user-required evidence, decision, documentation, performance, residual-risk, predecessor, and rollback metadata before later Work Items begin.
guidelines: Keep derived report views deterministic and do not permit them to become an evidence authority.
Do not treat repository-local or fixture evidence as Provider-backed evidence.

intent.problem: Task Outcome reports can currently contain warnings or not-run evidence without a structured limitation, residual risk, required evidence, decision owner, or explicit forbidden claim. This lets a human-facing report appear complete while omitting what cannot safely be trusted.
constraints: Preserve the immutable Task Outcome as the evidence-backed source; Markdown and human reports remain derived views.
Do not claim Provider-backed governance evidence in this Work Item.
Fail closed for incomplete warning, limitation, residual-risk, and forbidden-claim relationships.
Use focused test-first changes and retain compatible valid Outcome reports.
intent.rationale: A structured cross-reference makes missing evidence visible to both validators and human reports without relying on prose interpretation.

problemStatement: Bind every warning and not-run result to a limitation and either a residual risk or a documented non-risk explanation, then make forbidden claims explicit in all Outcome presentations.
rawUserRequest: Complete WI-01 outcome-residual-risk-binding. Warnings must map to limitations, residual risk or non-risk explanation, affected claims, required evidence, and human decision; missing relationships must fail closed. The user authorizes required Contract writes and the bootstrap extension that makes later Contracts carry the requested metadata.

declaredIntent.summary: Enforce evidence-backed Outcome limitations, residual risks, and forbidden claims.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: warning and not-run evidence require structured limitations and human-readable forbidden claims
scenarioCoverage.expected: Focused regression tests prove that incomplete mappings fail and complete mappings render consistently in JSON, Markdown, and the human report.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused Task Outcome schema, validator, generator, Markdown renderer, human report, and Contract validator tests after implementation.

requiredEvidence: Focused regression receipts for schema, validator, generator, renderer, human report, and Contract validation.
A generated Outcome that demonstrates warning-to-limitation-to-risk and forbidden-claim bindings.
humanDecisionPoints: A repository administrator must accept or resolve any high or critical residual risk before a blocked claim can be enabled.
documentationImpact: The machine-readable Outcome schema and Capability Truth Matrix describe the changed report boundary; no separate user guide is required because generated reports expose the new sections.
performanceImpact: The mapping is linear in the number of warnings and risks and is covered by focused local tests; no external verification is introduced.
residualRiskExpectation: Provider-backed branch protection, independent review, identity, and merge enforcement remain not_run, not_claimed, and external_dependency for this remediation cycle.
predecessorClosureEvidence: No predecessor exists because this is the first Work Item in the mandated sequence.
rollbackPlan: Revert the WI-01 commit set, regenerate status, and rerun the focused Outcome and Contract-validation test receipts before starting a replacement Work Item.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized required writes in this and subsequent Work Item Contracts, including the bootstrap Contract-model extension.

rollbackNote: Revert the WI-01 branch commit(s), restoring the prior Outcome schema, validator, generators, renderers, Contract validation rules, focused tests, and generated status through the normal Git and Work Item closure process.
